waveformDisabled: Audio waveform visualization has been automatically disabled for videos longer than 30 minutes to improve performance.
srtOnlyMode: SRT-only mode - Timeline visualization based on subtitle timings
moveRange: Drag to move subtitles in range
autoArrangeTip: Pick a smart narration speed and arrange so it fits the video timing — does everything in one click
arrangeTip: Pack the clips on the lane in order, allowing a small overlap (no speed change)
narrationSpeedTip: Globally speed the narration audio (applies on release; 1.00× = natural)
perLineFitTip: How much each clip may speed up on its own to fit its slot (small = gentle, keeps speech natural)
pullSubtitlesTip: Move the subtitle timings to match the narration lane, then refresh the narration
resetLaneTip: Restore natural speed and clear the staged arrangement
